desc: A mystical lantern fox, four-legged, cream fur, single bushy tail ending in a glowing gold light orb, big pointed ears, narrow clever eyes. High quality 16-bit pixel art game pet, crisp pixels, right-facing 3/4 view, full body, dark violet outline, pixel cluster shading with clear light and shadow, palette of lavender, pale violet, cream, ivory and deep navy, no props, no background.
